title: Generative AI: Large Language Model Optimization
description: Deep dive into fine-tuning techniques for LLMs. Learn to implement PEFT and LoRA for domain-specific language models using NVIDIA hardware.

title: Computer Vision for Industrial Inspection
description: Implement real-time defect detection systems. Learn to use the DeepStream SDK for building high-throughput video analytics pipelines.

title: Introduction to Omniverse and 3D Workflows
description: An entry-level guide to building collaborative 3D worlds. Explore USD (Universal Scene Description) and real-time physics simulation.

title: High Performance Computing with CUDA Python
description: Bridge the gap between Python ease-of-use and CUDA performance. Learn to write custom kernels using Numba for massively parallel processing.

title: Reinforcement Learning for Robotics
description: Master the Isaac Sim environment. Train autonomous agents to navigate complex environments using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO).

title: Ethical AI and Bias Mitigation
description: Essential framework for understanding algorithmic bias. Learn practical techniques for auditing models and ensuring fairness in production AI.
